data_product_overview:
## About this dashboard
Understanding the relationship between prescribing and dispensing is critical for ensuring accurate reimbursement and monitoring prescribing behaviour. The Prescriber Dispenser Report in ePACT2 provides detailed insights into which prescribers issued prescriptions and which dispensers processed them. This report captures data from NHS Prescription Services, including prescriber details, dispensing contractor information, and associated costs.

The report enables users to identify patterns such as cross-boundary dispensing, high-volume prescribers, and potential anomalies in prescribing and dispensing activity. It supports financial reconciliation by linking prescribing decisions to dispensing outcomes, ensuring that payments are accurate and compliant with NHS regulations.

The aim of the Prescriber Dispenser Report is to provide transparency and support medicines optimisation by highlighting prescribing and dispensing relationships. It helps commissioners and practices understand the flow of prescriptions across organisational boundaries and assess whether variation is warranted. While the report offers detailed operational insights, it should be used alongside other dashboards to provide context and inform strategic decisions. Its intention is to promote accountability, reduce errors, and support best practice in prescribing and dispensing.
